recipe.title: Aloo Gobi
recipe.description: Potatoes and cauliflower roasted dry with turmeric, cumin, and ginger — golden edges, soft centers, no gravy needed.
steps: Sizzle cumin seeds in oil, then add ginger.
Add potatoes and cook 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add cauliflower, turmeric, and coriander; toss to coat.
Cover and cook on low until tender, about 15 minutes.
Uncover to crisp the edges, then finish with coriander.

recipe.title: Arroz con Leche
recipe.description: Creamy cinnamon rice pudding, served warm or chilled. Makes 8 servings.
ingredients: granulated sugar, 1 cup. Optional toppings: ground cinnamon, nuts, raisins
steps: Put the rice, water, cinnamon sticks, and salt in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Lower the heat, cover, and cook gently for 15 minutes.
Stir in the milk and sugar.
Bring back to a boil, then immediately reduce the heat to low.
Cook for 25–30 minutes, stirring frequently, until thick and creamy.
Remove the cinnamon sticks.
Serve warm, or refrigerate for 2 hours to serve chilled.
Add any optional toppings you like.

recipe.title: Arroz Rojo
recipe.description: Fluffy tomato rice with carrots, peas, corn, and pickled jalapeño. Makes 8 servings.
ingredients: broth, up to 3 cups as needed
pickled jalapeños, 1–2. Optional: carrots, ¾ cup
steps: Blend the tomatoes, chopped onion, garlic, and salt until smooth.
Strain the tomato mixture into a measuring jug.
Measure enough broth so the tomato mixture and broth together make 4 cups; keep them separate for now.
Heat the oil in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the rice and stir for 3–4 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the tomato mixture and cook for 3 minutes.
Pour in the measured broth.
Add parsley, pickled jalapeños, and any optional vegetables you are using.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook over low heat for about 15 minutes, until the rice is tender.
If the rice is still firm but the liquid is gone, add 2 tbsp water and cook covered for 2 more minutes.
Remove from the heat and rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Fluff the rice gently before serving.

recipe.title: Avocado Toast
recipe.description: Creamy smashed avocado on crisp toast with lemon, chili flakes, and a little olive oil. It is fast, filling, and easy to adjust with whatever toppings you have.
steps: Toast the bread until crisp.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Spread avocado over toast and finish with olive oil and chili flakes.

recipe.title: Avocado, Black Bean & Potato Salad
recipe.description: Black beans, tender potato, avocado, and tomato with a lime-cilantro dressing. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 240 g cooked black beans, drained and rinsed
250 g potatoes, cut into 2 cm cubes
1 medium avocado, about 150 g flesh, diced
steps: Cover potatoes with water in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 12–15 minutes, until tender.
Drain and cool for 5 minutes.
Whisk lime juice, oil, cumin, and salt in a large bowl.
Add black beans, potatoes, tomatoes, and cilantro.
Toss gently to coat.
Fold in avocado just before serving.
Divide between two bowls.

recipe.title: Baba Ganoush
recipe.description: Smoky charred eggplant whipped with tahini, lemon, and garlic. Char it hard — the burnt skin is where the flavor lives.
steps: Char the eggplants whole over a flame or under the broiler until collapsed.
Rest covered 10 minutes, then scoop out the flesh and drain.
Mash with tahini, lemon, garlic, and salt — keep some texture.
Swirl with olive oil and scatter pomegranate and parsley.

recipe.title: Baklava
recipe.description: Layers of crisp filo, butter, and spiced walnuts soaked in citrus-honey syrup. Patience with the brushing pays off in shatter.
steps: Toss the walnuts with cinnamon.
Layer half the filo in a buttered tin, brushing every sheet.
Spread the nuts, then layer the remaining filo the same way.
Cut into diamonds and bake at 170°C for 40 minutes until golden.
Boil honey, sugar, lemon, and water into a syrup.
Pour over the hot baklava and let it soak.

recipe.title: Banana Oat Pancakes
recipe.description: A small-batch pancake made with banana, oats, and egg. Use certified gluten-free oats if needed.
steps: Blend banana, egg, oats, and baking powder.
Cook small pancakes in a lightly oiled pan.
Serve with maple syrup.

recipe.title: Beetroot & Pea Pulao
recipe.description: Ruby-colored rice with tender beetroot, peas, and chickpeas, scented with cinnamon and cumin. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 200 g cooked chickpeas, drained and rinsed
200 g raw beetroot, peeled and coarsely grated
steps: Rinse the rice well.
Heat oil in a lidded saucepan over medium heat.
Add cumin, cinnamon, and ginger; stir for 30 seconds.
Add grated beetroot and cook for 4 minutes, stirring.
Add rice, chickpeas, peas, water, and salt.
Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to low, and cook for 15 minutes.
Check that the rice is tender; if needed, add 2 tbsp water and cook for another 3 minutes.
Remove from the heat and rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Remove the cinnamon stick, fluff gently, and divide into two servings.

recipe.title: Black Bean & Rice Stuffed Peppers
recipe.description: Sweet bell peppers baked with a filling of black beans, rice, tomato, and oregano. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 2 large sweet red bell peppers, about 400 g
240 g cooked black beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C.
Halve sweet bell peppers lengthwise and remove the seeds.
Rub the cut peppers with half the oil and place in a baking dish.
Mix beans, rice, 150 g tomatoes, cumin, oregano, and half the salt.
Spoon into the four pepper halves.
Mix remaining tomatoes, oil, and salt and spoon around the peppers.
Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake for 10 more minutes, until the peppers are tender and the filling is hot.
Finish with cilantro and lime juice.
Serve two pepper halves per person with sauce.

recipe.title: Black Bean Masa Pockets
recipe.description: Tlacoyo-inspired oval corn masa pockets filled with mashed black beans, topped with tomato and cilantro. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 240 g cooked black beans, drained and rinsed
200 ml warm water, plus 2 tbsp for the beans
steps: Mash black beans in a saucepan with cumin, half the salt, and 2 tbsp water.
Cook over medium-low heat for 5 minutes, stirring, until thick enough to hold a mound.
Cool slightly.
Mix masa harina with remaining salt and 180 ml of the warm water.
Knead for 2 minutes to make a soft dough that holds together without sticking.
Add the remaining water little by little if it cracks.
Cover and rest for 5 minutes.
Divide dough into six balls.
Flatten each in your palm, add one-sixth of the beans, and bring dough around the filling.
Seal and gently flatten into an oval about 1 cm thick.
Keep the other pieces covered while shaping.
Brush a large skillet with oil and heat over medium-low heat.
Cook pockets in two batches for 5–6 minutes per side, until lightly browned and the masa is cooked through.
Mix tomato, cilantro, and lime juice and spoon over the pockets.
Serve three per person.

recipe.title: Black Bean Quesadilla
recipe.description: A crisp tortilla filled with black beans, cheese, and salsa. It is one of the easiest hot meals to make in a skillet.
steps: Fill tortilla with beans, cheese, and salsa.
Cook in a lightly oiled skillet until golden.
Slice into wedges.

recipe.title: Butter Chicken
recipe.description: Charred marinated chicken folded into a silky tomato-butter sauce with cream and garam masala. The Delhi classic everyone falls for.
steps: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, and spices for 30 minutes.
Sear the chicken hard until charred at the edges; set aside.
Simmer passata with butter and chili powder for 10 minutes.
Return the chicken, add cream, and simmer 8 more minutes.
Finish with garam masala and serve with rice or naan.

recipe.title: Cabbage, Pea & Potato Skillet
recipe.description: A gently spiced cabbage and potato skillet with peas, finished with lemon. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 350 g potatoes, cut into 1.5 cm cubes
steps: Heat oil in a large lidded skillet over medium heat.
Add cumin and ginger and stir for 30 seconds.
Add potatoes, turmeric, salt, and 120 ml water.
Cover and cook on medium-low for 12 minutes, stirring once.
Add cabbage and peas.
Cover and cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes and cabbage are tender.
Add 2 tbsp water if the pan dries out.
Uncover and cook for 2 minutes to evaporate excess liquid.
Finish with lemon juice and divide into two servings.

recipe.title: Caprese Salad
recipe.description: Tomatoes, mozzarella, basil, olive oil, and balsamic in a simple no-cook salad. It is best when tomatoes are ripe.
steps: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella.
Layer with basil.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic, then season.

recipe.title: Caprese Salad
recipe.description: Ripe tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, and basil with good olive oil — the colors of the Italian flag on a plate. No cooking required.
steps: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella into thick rounds.
Arrange them in alternating, overlapping slices.
Tuck basil leaves between the layers.
Season with flaky salt and pepper, then drizzle generously with olive oil.

recipe.title: Chana Masala
recipe.description: Chickpeas simmered in a punchy onion-tomato masala with cumin, coriander, and a squeeze of lemon. Hearty, vegan, and pantry-friendly.
steps: Brown the onions in oil until deeply golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and ground spices for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and cook down into a thick masala.
Stir in chickpeas with a cup of water; simmer 15 minutes.
Finish with garam masala and lemon juice.

recipe.title: Chicken Lettuce Wraps
recipe.description: Ground chicken cooked with ginger, garlic, and tamari, then spooned into crisp lettuce cups. It is light but satisfying.
steps: Cook chicken with garlic and ginger.
Season with tamari and sesame oil.
Spoon into lettuce leaves and top with scallion.

recipe.title: Chicken Shawarma
recipe.description: Oven-roasted chicken thighs in a deep shawarma marinade of cumin, coriander, turmeric, and lemon — sliced thin and piled into flatbread.
ingredients: 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp paprika
steps: Whisk oil, lemon, garlic, and all the spices into a marinade.
Coat the chicken and marinate at least 30 minutes.
Roast at 220°C for 25 minutes until charred at the edges.
Rest, then slice thinly.
Pile into flatbreads with pickles and tahini or garlic sauce.

recipe.title: Chicken Tagine
recipe.description: Moroccan chicken braised slowly with preserved lemon, green olives, saffron, and ginger until falling off the bone.
ingredients: 1 tsp ground ginger and 1 tsp turmeric
steps: Brown the chicken thighs in olive oil; set aside.
Soften the onions with ginger, turmeric, and saffron.
Return the chicken with a cup of water; cover and braise 45 minutes.
Add preserved lemon and olives for the last 10 minutes.
Shower with herbs and serve with couscous or bread.

recipe.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipe.description: Charred yogurt-marinated chicken in a spiced, creamy tomato-onion gravy. Bolder and smokier than its butter chicken cousin.
steps: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, and spices for 30 minutes.
Grill or sear the chicken until charred; set aside.
Cook onions until golden, add tomatoes, and simmer 12 minutes; blend smooth.
Return the sauce with the chicken and cream; simmer 8 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with rice or naan.

recipe.title: Chickpea Salad Sandwich
recipe.description: Mashed chickpeas mixed with mustard, lemon, celery, and herbs, then piled onto bread. It is a quick plant-based sandwich filling.
steps: Mash chickpeas until chunky.
Mix in mayo, mustard, celery, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Serve between slices of bread.

recipe.title: Chickpea, Spinach & Tomato Pot
recipe.description: A hearty tomato stew with chickpeas, spinach, and small potato cubes. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 300 g cooked chickpeas, drained and rinsed
250 g potatoes, cut into 1 cm cubes
steps: Put oil, tomatoes, oregano, potatoes, water, and salt in a saucepan and bring to a simmer.
Partly cover and simmer for 15–18 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potato cubes are tender.
Add chickpeas and cook for 4 minutes. Stir in spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted.
Add a little water if needed to loosen the sauce. Divide into two bowls.

recipe.title: Chilaquiles Rojos
recipe.description: Red-salsa tortillas with crema, queso fresco, onion, and cilantro. Makes 4 servings.
ingredients: salt. Optional cooked shredded chicken, 1½ cups
For salsa: white onion, ⅛ medium
steps: To make the salsa, put the tomatoes, jalapeño or serrano, garlic, and ⅛ onion in a saucepan and cover with water.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes.
Transfer the vegetables to a blender with ½ cup of the cooking water.
Blend into a smooth salsa, following your blender’s instructions for hot liquids, then season with salt.
Reserve 1 tbsp of the oil for the salsa and heat the rest in a skillet.
Fry the tortilla wedges in batches until crisp.
Drain the wedges on paper towels.
Heat the reserved 1 tbsp oil in a wide pan.
Add 2 cups of the salsa and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the epazote, tortilla wedges, and cooked chicken if using.
Toss gently and cook for 2 minutes.
Serve with crema, queso fresco, onion rings, and cilantro.

recipe.title: Cinnamon Pumpkin & Lentil Rice
recipe.description: Roasted pumpkin over lentil rice, gently scented with cinnamon and cumin and finished with parsley. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 400 g peeled pumpkin, cut into 2 cm cubes
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C.
Toss pumpkin with oil, cinnamon, cumin, and half the salt.
Spread on a lined tray and roast for 25–30 minutes, turning once, until tender and browned at the edges.
Meanwhile, rinse rice and place in a saucepan with 220 ml water and remaining salt.
Bring to a boil, cover, and cook on low for 12 minutes.
Rest off the heat for 5 minutes.
Warm lentils with 2 tbsp water in a small saucepan for 3–4 minutes.
Fold into the cooked rice.
Divide lentil rice between two bowls. Top with pumpkin, parsley, and lemon juice.

recipe.title: Classic Hummus
recipe.description: Silky-smooth chickpea dip with tahini, lemon, and garlic, pooled with olive oil. The secret is blending longer than feels reasonable.
steps: Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and cumin.
Stream in reserved chickpea liquid until silky, blending 2–3 minutes.
Season with salt and adjust lemon.
Swirl onto a plate, pool with olive oil, and dust with cumin.

recipe.title: Classic Lasagna
recipe.description: Layers of slow-simmered beef ragù, béchamel, and pasta baked until bubbling and golden. A Sunday project that feeds a crowd.
steps: Brown the beef with onion and carrot, add passata, and simmer 30 minutes.
Make a béchamel: melt butter, stir in flour, then whisk in milk until thick.
Layer ragù, pasta, and béchamel in a baking dish, repeating three times.
Top with béchamel and Parmesan.
Bake at 190°C for 35 minutes until golden; rest 10 minutes.

recipe.title: Coconut Cinnamon Rice Pudding
recipe.description: A coconut-milk adaptation of arroz con leche, with cinnamon, orange zest, and a small amount of sugar. Makes 2 servings.
steps: Rinse the rice.
Put rice, water, cinnamon, and salt in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer partly covered for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add coconut milk and sugar.
Simmer gently, uncovered, for 15–18 minutes, stirring often, until the rice is tender and the mixture is creamy.
Add a little water if it thickens before the rice is cooked.
Remove the cinnamon stick and stir in orange zest.
Rest off the heat for 5 minutes, allowing the pudding to thicken.
Divide between two small bowls and serve warm.

recipe.title: Coconut Rice with Peas
recipe.description: Tender basmati rice with peas, chickpeas, coconut, and fresh ginger. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 200 g cooked chickpeas, drained and rinsed
steps: Rinse the rice.
Combine it with 220 ml water and salt in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil, cover, and cook on low for 12 minutes.
Rest off the heat for 5 minutes.
Heat oil in a wide pan over medium heat.
Add cumin, ginger, and curry leaves; stir for 30 seconds.
Add peas, chickpeas, and 3 tbsp water.
Cover and cook for 5 minutes, until the peas are tender and chickpeas are hot.
Add shredded coconut and stir for 1 minute.
Fold in the cooked rice and divide between two bowls.

recipe.title: Cucumber Avocado Sushi Bowl
recipe.description: Sushi-inspired rice topped with avocado, cucumber, nori, and sesame. It gives you the flavor of a roll without rolling anything.
steps: Season rice with rice vinegar.
Top with avocado, cucumber, and nori.
Finish with tamari and sesame seeds.

recipe.title: Cucumber Chana & Potato Salad
recipe.description: Chickpeas, tender potato, cucumber, and tomato with lemon and toasted cumin. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 240 g cooked chickpeas, drained and rinsed
250 g potatoes, cut into 2 cm cubes
steps: Cover potatoes with water in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 12–15 minutes until tender.
Drain and cool for 5 minutes.
Toast ground cumin in a dry small pan over low heat for 20 seconds, then transfer to a bowl.
Whisk with lemon juice, oil, and salt.
Add chickpeas, potatoes, cucumber, tomato, and cilantro. Toss gently until coated.
Divide into two servings and serve warm or at room temperature.

recipe.title: Cumin Potato & Chickpea Skillet
recipe.description: Golden potatoes and chickpeas with cumin, coriander, and lemon; a hearty adaptation of jeera aloo. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 400 g potatoes, cut into 2 cm cubes
240 g cooked chickpeas, drained and rinsed
steps: Place potatoes in a saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 10–12 minutes until just tender, then drain well.
Heat oil in a wide skillet over medium heat.
Add cumin and stir for 30 seconds.
Add drained potatoes, coriander, turmeric, and salt.
Cook for 7 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden in places.
Add chickpeas and 3 tbsp water; cook for 4 minutes until hot.
Remove from the heat and fold in lemon juice and cilantro.
Serve in two bowls.

recipe.title: Dal Tadka
recipe.description: Yellow lentils cooked soft, finished with a sizzling tadka of ghee, cumin, garlic, and dried chilies poured over at the table.
ingredients: 200 g toor or yellow moong dal
steps: Simmer the dal with turmeric and tomato until soft, about 25 minutes.
Whisk the dal to a creamy consistency and season with salt.
Heat ghee and sizzle cumin, garlic, and dried chilies until golden.
Pour the tadka over the dal and cover for a minute.
Finish with fresh coriander.

recipe.title: Egg Fried Rice
recipe.description: Leftover rice stir-fried with egg, peas, carrots, and tamari. It is quick, flexible, and best with cold rice.
steps: Scramble eggs in oil and set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables and rice.
Add tamari, eggs, and scallions.

recipe.title: Eggplant & Chickpea Tomato Bake
recipe.description: A Lebanese-inspired eggplant and chickpea bake with tomato, cumin, and parsley. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 450 g eggplant, cut into 2 cm cubes
300 g cooked chickpeas, drained and rinsed
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C.
Toss eggplant with oil and half the salt.
Spread on a lined tray and roast for 25 minutes, turning halfway.
Combine tomatoes, chickpeas, cumin, cinnamon, and remaining salt in a baking dish.
Fold roasted eggplant into the sauce.
Cover and bake for 15 minutes.
Uncover and bake for 5 minutes more, until bubbling and the eggplant is soft.
Stir in lemon juice and parsley.
Divide into two portions, spooning the sauce over the vegetables.

recipe.title: Eggplant & Lentil Tomato Rice
recipe.description: Roasted eggplant and lentils in an oregano-tomato sauce over rice. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 350 g eggplant, cut into 2 cm cubes
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C.
Toss eggplant with half the oil and half the salt.
Spread on a lined tray and roast for 25 minutes, turning halfway.
Rinse rice and combine with 220 ml water in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil, cover, and cook on low for 12 minutes.
Rest off the heat for 5 minutes.
Simmer tomatoes, oregano, remaining oil, salt, and 100 ml water in a wide pan for 10 minutes.
Add lentils and roasted eggplant and simmer for 4 minutes.
Stir in basil.
Divide rice between two bowls and top with the eggplant mixture.

recipe.title: Enfrijoladas
recipe.description: Soft tortillas wrapped in bean sauce, finished with cream and fresh cheese. Makes 8 servings.
ingredients: Mexican cream or heavy cream, 1 cup
queso fresco, 1 cup. Optional: avocado slices and chipotles in adobo
steps: Pour the prepared bean purée into a saucepan.
Warm over low heat until gently simmering.
Heat a dry skillet over medium heat.
Warm each tortilla for about 30 seconds per side.
Use tongs to dip each tortilla into the warm bean sauce.
Fold the coated tortillas and place them on serving plates.
Spoon over the cream and crumble the queso fresco on top.
Add avocado slices or chipotle if using.

recipe.title: Esquites
recipe.description: Tender corn with crema, crumbled cheese, chili, and lime. Makes 4 servings.
ingredients: chopped fresh epazote, 4 tbsp if available
crumbled queso fresco or cotija, 6 tbsp
steps: Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Stir in the corn, water, epazote if available, and serrano if using.
Cover and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the corn is tender but still has a little bite.
Season with salt.
Spoon the corn into serving cups.
Add crema or mayonnaise and the crumbled cheese.
Finish with chili powder and lime if using.

recipe.title: Falafel
recipe.description: Crisp-shelled, herb-green chickpea fritters. Made from soaked (never canned) chickpeas for that essential crumbly-light interior.
ingredients: Large handful each parsley and coriander
steps: Pulse soaked chickpeas with onion, garlic, herbs, and spices to a coarse rubble.
Chill the mix 30 minutes, then stir in baking soda.
Shape into walnut-sized balls.
Fry at 175°C until deeply browned, about 4 minutes.
Serve in pita with tahini sauce and pickles.

recipe.title: Fattoush
recipe.description: A crunchy Levantine salad of crisp vegetables and toasted pita shards, tangy with sumac and lemon.
steps: Toast the pita until crisp, then break into shards.
Chop the vegetables into rough, chunky pieces.
Whisk lemon, olive oil, sumac, and salt into a dressing.
Toss everything together just before serving so the pita stays crisp.

recipe.title: Frijoles Refritos
recipe.description: Creamy refried beans with a little onion and crumbled cheese. Makes 6 servings.
ingredients: For refrying: Prepared beans with some broth, 3 cups
For refrying: chopped onion, ⅓ cup
For refrying: oil or lard, 3 tbsp
For refrying: salt. Optional cheese and tortilla chips for serving
steps: Sort through the dried beans and discard any stones or damaged beans.
Rinse the beans under running water.
Put them in a large pot with 8 cups water, ¼ onion, 2 garlic cloves, and 1 tsp lard or olive oil.
Bring to a boil, then lower the heat to a gentle simmer.
Cook for 1½–3 hours, until the beans are tender. Add water as needed to keep them covered.
Near the end of cooking, add epazote, salt, and the serrano if using.
Measure 3 cups cooked beans with some of their broth for refrying; save the remaining beans separately.
Heat 3 tbsp oil or lard in a skillet over medium-low heat.
Add ⅓ cup chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the measured beans and broth.
Mash the beans in the pan.
Cook, stirring, until as thick as you like.
Adjust the salt and add cheese if using. Serve with tortilla chips if desired.

recipe.title: Garlic Naan
recipe.description: Soft, blistered flatbread brushed with garlic butter, made in a screaming-hot skillet — no tandoor required.
steps: Knead flour, yogurt, yeast, sugar, and water into a soft dough.
Rise 1 hour until doubled.
Divide and roll into teardrop shapes.
Cook in a screaming-hot dry skillet until blistered on both sides.
Brush with garlic butter and scatter with coriander.

recipe.title: Garlic Shrimp Tacos
recipe.description: Shrimp sauteed with garlic and lime, tucked into warm tortillas with cabbage. Use corn tortillas for a gluten-free version.
steps: Cook shrimp with garlic and chili powder.
Warm tortillas.
Fill with cabbage, shrimp, and lime juice.

recipe.title: Gentle Moong Dal Khichdi
recipe.description: A soft one-pot meal of rice, yellow lentils, carrots, and peas, seasoned with ginger and cumin. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 100 g dry split yellow mung lentils, rinsed
steps: Rinse the rice and lentils separately until the water is mostly clear.
Dice the carrot into 1 cm pieces.
Warm the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add cumin and stir for 30 seconds.
Add ginger and turmeric and stir for another 20 seconds.
Add rice, lentils, carrot, salt, and 900 ml water.
Bring to a boil, then partly cover and simmer gently for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the peas and simmer for 5–8 minutes, until the rice and lentils are very soft.
Add a little water if needed for a spoonable consistency.
Divide between two bowls.

recipe.title: Ginger Masoor Dal & Rice
recipe.description: Red lentils simmered with tomato and ginger, served over basmati rice. Makes 2 servings.
steps: Combine rice with 220 ml water in a small saucepan.
Bring to a boil, cover, and cook on low for 12 minutes.
Rest off the heat for 5 minutes.
Heat oil in another saucepan over medium heat.
Add cumin and ginger and cook for 30 seconds.
Stir in tomatoes and turmeric; cook for 5 minutes.
Add lentils, the remaining 630 ml water, and salt.
Bring to a boil, then simmer partly covered for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are soft.
Stir lemon juice into the dal.
Add a splash of water if too thick.
Divide rice and dal between two bowls.

recipe.title: Greek Yogurt Berry Bowl
recipe.description: A no-cook bowl with thick yogurt, berries, honey, and crunchy seeds. It works for breakfast, a snack, or a light dessert.
steps: Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with berries, honey, chia seeds, and granola.
Serve cold.

recipe.title: Green Bean & White Bean Tomato Pot
recipe.description: Tender green beans and white beans in a tomato and olive-oil sauce, inspired by loubieh bi zeit. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 300 g green beans, trimmed and cut into 3 cm pieces
300 g cooked cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Combine oil, tomatoes, cumin, water, and salt in a wide lidded saucepan.
Bring to a gentle simmer.
Add green beans, cover, and simmer for 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender.
Add a splash of water if the sauce gets too thick.
Stir in white beans and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes, until heated through.
Finish with lemon juice and parsley.
Divide into two bowls.

recipe.title: Green Bean, Potato & Chickpea Salad
recipe.description: Warm potatoes and green beans tossed with chickpeas, basil, and lemon. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 350 g potatoes, cut into 2 cm cubes
250 g green beans, trimmed and halved
240 g cooked chickpeas, drained and rinsed
steps: Cover potatoes with water in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add green beans and simmer for another 5–7 minutes, until potatoes and beans are tender. Drain well.
Whisk lemon juice, oil, and salt in a large bowl. Add warm potatoes, green beans, and chickpeas; toss gently.
Fold in basil and divide into two servings.

recipe.title: Hummus Veggie Wrap
recipe.description: A soft tortilla filled with hummus, crunchy vegetables, and greens. It is a low-effort lunch that travels well.
steps: Spread hummus over the tortilla.
Add cucumber, carrot, spinach, and lemon juice.
Roll tightly and slice in half.

recipe.title: Lamb Kofta
recipe.description: Juicy spiced lamb skewers with onion, parsley, and warm spices, grilled until charred and served with yogurt sauce.
ingredients: 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1 tsp paprika
steps: Knead the lamb with onion, parsley, and spices until tacky.
Shape onto skewers in long ovals; chill 15 minutes.
Grill or pan-sear on high, turning, about 8 minutes total.
Rest briefly and serve with yogurt and flatbread.

recipe.title: Lemon Cannellini & Potato Salad
recipe.description: Tender potatoes and white beans with cucumber, parsley, and a bright lemon dressing. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 300 g cooked cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
300 g potatoes, cut into 2 cm cubes
steps: Cover potatoes with water in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 12–15 minutes, until tender.
Drain and cool for 5 minutes.
Whisk lemon juice, oil, and salt in a large bowl.
Add potatoes, beans, cucumber, tomatoes, and parsley. Toss gently.
Divide into two portions and serve warm or at room temperature.

recipe.title: Lemon Chickpea Rice
recipe.description: Bright lemon rice with chickpeas, grated carrot, curry leaves, and turmeric. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 240 g cooked chickpeas, drained and rinsed
steps: Rinse the rice.
Put it in a saucepan with 250 ml water and half the salt.
Bring to a boil, cover, and cook on low for 12 minutes.
Remove from the heat and rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, warm the oil in a wide pan.
Add cumin and curry leaves; stir for 30 seconds.
Add turmeric and carrot and cook for 3 minutes.
Add chickpeas, remaining salt, and 2 tbsp water. Cook for 4 minutes until hot.
Gently fold in cooked rice, lemon zest, and lemon juice. Divide into two servings.

recipe.title: Lemon Fava & Potato Bowl
recipe.description: Warm mashed fava beans and tender potatoes topped with cucumber, tomato, and parsley; a ful-inspired bowl. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 300 g cooked fava beans, drained and rinsed
250 g potatoes, cut into 1.5 cm cubes
150 ml water, plus water for boiling
steps: Cover potatoes with water in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 12–15 minutes, until tender, then drain.
In another saucepan, combine fava beans, 150 ml water, cumin, and salt.
Simmer for 6 minutes, stirring.
Mash about half the beans with a fork.
Fold potatoes into the warm beans.
Stir in lemon juice and olive oil.
Divide into two bowls and top with cucumber, tomatoes, and parsley.

recipe.title: Lemon Red Lentil & Potato Soup
recipe.description: A Lebanese-inspired red lentil soup with potato, carrot, cumin, and a bright lemon finish. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 200 g potatoes, cut into 1.5 cm cubes
steps: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add carrot and cook for 4 minutes, stirring.
Add cumin and stir for 20 seconds.
Add lentils, potatoes, water, and salt.
Bring to a boil, reduce the heat, and simmer partly covered for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Check that the potatoes and lentils are tender.
Mash some potato and lentils against the side of the pan to thicken the soup, leaving plenty of texture.
Add a little water if needed.
Remove from the heat and stir in lemon juice and parsley.
Divide between two bowls.

recipe.title: Lemon Spinach & White Bean Pot
recipe.description: White beans and spinach simmered with small potato cubes, coriander, and lemon. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 300 g cooked cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
250 g potatoes, cut into 1 cm cubes
steps: Warm oil in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add coriander and stir for 20 seconds.
Add potatoes, water, and salt.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15–18 minutes, until potato cubes are tender.
Add beans and spinach.
Simmer uncovered for 5 minutes, stirring until spinach has wilted and the beans are hot.
Mash a few beans to thicken the liquid.
Stir in lemon juice and cilantro, and divide into two bowls.

recipe.title: Lentil, Carrot & Rice Soup
recipe.description: A rustic lentil soup with carrot, rice, tomato, and thyme. Makes 2 servings.
steps: Heat oil in a large saucepan.
Add carrots and thyme and cook over medium heat for 4 minutes.
Add rinsed rice, tomatoes, water, and salt.
Bring to a boil, then simmer partly covered for 18 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add lentils and simmer for 5 minutes, until rice and carrots are tender.
Add a splash of water if needed.
Stir in parsley and divide between two bowls.

recipe.title: Mango Lassi
recipe.description: A thick, cooling blend of ripe mango, yogurt, and cardamom. Breakfast, dessert, or the answer to a spicy curry.
steps: Blend mango, yogurt, sugar, and cardamom until smooth.
Loosen with a splash of cold milk to taste.
Pour over ice and dust with a little extra cardamom.

recipe.title: Margherita Pizza
recipe.description: The Naples classic: blistered crust, crushed tomatoes, melted mozzarella, and fresh basil. Simple ingredients, treated well.
steps: Heat the oven to its highest setting with a pizza stone or tray inside.
Stretch the dough into a 12-inch round on a floured surface.
Spread tomatoes thinly, season with salt, and tear over the mozzarella.
Bake 7–10 minutes until the crust is blistered and the cheese bubbles.
Finish with basil leaves and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipe.title: Microwave Loaded Potato
recipe.description: A fluffy microwave potato topped with yogurt, cheese, and scallions. It is warm, cheap, and filling with almost no cleanup.
steps: Pierce potato and microwave until tender.
Split open and season.
Top with yogurt, cheese, and scallion.

recipe.title: Mild Black Bean & Sweet Potato Pot
recipe.description: Black beans and sweet potatoes simmered with tomato, cumin, and oregano, finished with lime. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 300 g cooked black beans, drained and rinsed
350 g sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1.5 cm cubes
steps: Warm oil in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add cumin and oregano and stir for 20 seconds.
Add sweet potatoes, tomatoes, water, and salt.
Bring to a simmer, partly cover, and cook for 18–22 minutes, until the sweet potato is tender.
Stir in black beans and simmer for 5 minutes, until hot.
Add a splash of water if needed for a thick stew.
Remove from heat and stir in lime juice and cilantro.
Divide between two bowls.

recipe.title: Minestrone Soup
recipe.description: A hearty vegetable soup with beans and small pasta, built on a slow-cooked soffritto. Endlessly adaptable to what's in the fridge.
steps: Sweat the onion, carrot, and celery in olive oil for 8 minutes.
Add garlic, then tomatoes and stock, and simmer 15 minutes.
Add beans, courgette, and pasta; cook until the pasta is tender.
Season and serve with a drizzle of olive oil.

recipe.title: Mushroom Risotto
recipe.description: Creamy Arborio rice cooked slowly with stock and stirred through golden mushrooms, Parmesan, and butter. Worth every stir.
steps: Sauté the mushrooms in olive oil until golden; set aside.
Soften the onion, then toast the rice for 2 minutes.
Add wine, then warm stock a ladle at a time, stirring until absorbed.
After about 18 minutes, fold in the mushrooms.
Beat in butter and Parmesan off the heat and rest 2 minutes.

recipe.title: Orange Sweet Potato & Pinto Bowl
recipe.description: Roasted sweet potato and pinto beans with orange, lime, and crisp cabbage. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 350 g sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 2 cm cubes
300 g cooked pinto beans, drained and rinsed
1 orange, peeled and cut into bite-sized pieces
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C.
Toss sweet potato with half the oil, cumin, and half the salt.
Spread on a lined tray and roast for 25–30 minutes, turning halfway, until tender.
Warm pinto beans in a small saucepan with 2 tbsp water for 4 minutes.
Toss cabbage with lime juice, remaining oil, and remaining salt.
Fold in orange pieces and cilantro.
Divide beans and sweet potato between two bowls and add the cabbage-orange salad alongside.

recipe.title: Palak Paneer
recipe.description: Soft paneer cubes in a vibrant spinach gravy scented with cumin, garlic, and a touch of cream. Comfort food in green.
steps: Blanch the spinach 2 minutes, cool in cold water, and blend smooth.
Fry cumin seeds, then soften the onion and ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomatoes and cook until jammy.
Pour in the spinach purée and simmer 8 minutes.
Fold in paneer and cream; warm through gently.

recipe.title: Parsley Quinoa & Chickpea Salad
recipe.description: An herb-forward, tabbouleh-inspired salad made with quinoa, chickpeas, cucumber, and tomato. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 240 g cooked chickpeas, drained and rinsed
10 g fresh mint leaves, finely chopped
steps: Put quinoa and 220 ml water in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to low, and cook for 15 minutes.
Remove from heat and rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Fluff quinoa and spread it on a wide plate to cool for 5 minutes while preparing the herbs and vegetables.
Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, and salt in a large bowl.
Add chickpeas, parsley, mint, tomatoes, and cucumber.
Fold in the quinoa. Toss well and divide between two bowls.

recipe.title: Peanut Butter Banana Oats
recipe.description: Warm oats stirred with banana and peanut butter. Use certified gluten-free oats if needed.
steps: Simmer oats with oat milk.
Stir in mashed banana.
Top with peanut butter, maple syrup, and cinnamon.

recipe.title: Penne all'Arrabbiata
recipe.description: The 'angry' pasta: penne in a garlicky tomato sauce with enough chili to bite back. Pantry-simple and ready in under half an hour.
steps: Boil the penne in salted water until al dente.
Soften garlic and chili flakes in olive oil without browning.
Add tomatoes, crush them down, and simmer 10 minutes.
Toss the pasta through the sauce with a splash of pasta water.
Finish with parsley and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipe.title: Pesto Gnocchi
recipe.description: Pillowy gnocchi tossed in a fresh basil pesto with Parmesan and toasted pine nuts. Twenty minutes, start to finish.
steps: Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan until golden.
Blend basil, most of the pine nuts, Parmesan, garlic, and olive oil into a pesto.
Boil the gnocchi until they float; reserve some cooking water.
Toss gnocchi with pesto, loosening with cooking water.
Top with the remaining pine nuts and extra Parmesan.

recipe.title: Pesto Gnocchi
recipe.description: Pillowy gnocchi tossed with pesto and cherry tomatoes. Store-bought pesto makes it nearly effortless.
steps: Boil gnocchi until they float.
Warm tomatoes in olive oil.
Toss gnocchi with pesto and Parmesan.

recipe.title: Pinto, Potato & Oregano Stew
recipe.description: Pinto beans and tender potato in a mild tomato sauce scented with oregano and cumin. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 300 g cooked pinto beans, drained and rinsed
350 g potatoes, cut into 1.5 cm cubes
steps: Heat oil in a saucepan over medium heat.
Stir in oregano and cumin for 20 seconds.
Add potatoes, tomatoes, water, and salt.
Bring to a simmer, partly cover, and cook for 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender.
Add pinto beans and simmer for 5 minutes.
Mash a few beans and potato cubes to thicken the sauce.
Finish with lime juice and cilantro.
Divide into two bowls.

recipe.title: Pumpkin & Chickpea Coconut Pot
recipe.description: Pumpkin and chickpeas in a mild ginger-coconut sauce, with basmati rice. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 350 g peeled pumpkin, cut into 2 cm cubes
240 g cooked chickpeas, drained and rinsed
steps: Rinse the rice.
Put it in a small saucepan with 180 ml water.
Bring to a boil, cover, and cook on low for 12 minutes.
Rest off the heat for 5 minutes.
Heat oil in a saucepan.
Add ginger, cumin, and coriander and stir over medium heat for 30 seconds.
Add pumpkin, chickpeas, coconut milk, remaining 200 ml water, and salt.
Bring to a gentle simmer.
Partly cover and cook for 18–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until pumpkin is tender.
Divide the rice and pumpkin mixture between two bowls.

recipe.title: Rajas con Crema
recipe.description: Roasted poblano strips in rich crema and melted Oaxaca cheese. Makes 4 servings.
steps: Place the poblanos under a hot broiler.
Broil for about 5 minutes per side, until the skins blister.
Put the peppers in a bowl and cover for 5 minutes.
Peel off the loosened skins.
Remove the stems and seeds, then slice the peppers into strips.
Melt the butter in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Stir in the pepper strips, crema, and salt.
Cook for 2 minutes.
Add the Oaxaca cheese and stir until melted.

recipe.title: Rajma
recipe.description: Kidney beans slow-simmered in a gingery onion-tomato gravy — north India's favorite Sunday lunch, made for spooning over rice.
ingredients: 2 cans kidney beans (or 250 g soaked and boiled)
steps: Sizzle cumin, then brown the grated onions well.
Add ginger-garlic paste and the tomato purée; cook until thick.
Stir in the spices, then the beans with a cup of water.
Simmer 20 minutes, mashing a few beans to thicken.
Finish with coriander and serve over rice.

recipe.title: Red Lentil Soup
recipe.description: A cozy one-pot soup made with red lentils, tomato, cumin, and lemon. Red lentils cook quickly and break down into a creamy texture.
steps: Cook onion in olive oil.
Add lentils, tomatoes, broth, and cumin.
Simmer until soft and finish with lemon.

recipe.title: Rice & Lentil Stuffed Tomatoes
recipe.description: Baked tomatoes filled with rice, lentils, and basil, with tender zucchini alongside. Makes 2 servings.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C.
Cut tops from tomatoes and scoop the pulp into a bowl, leaving the shells intact.
Chop the pulp.
Mix rice, lentils, chopped pulp, basil, oregano, half the oil, and half the salt.
Spoon into the tomato shells; put any extra filling around them in a baking dish.
Arrange zucchini around the tomatoes.
Drizzle with remaining oil and salt.
Replace tomato tops and cover the dish with foil.
Bake for 25 minutes.
Uncover and bake for 10–15 minutes more, until tomatoes are tender and the filling is steaming hot.
Serve two tomatoes per person with zucchini.

recipe.title: Rice & Lentil Stuffed Zucchini
recipe.description: Baked zucchini boats filled with rice, lentils, tomato, and mint, inspired by Lebanese stuffed vegetables. Makes 2 servings.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C.
Halve zucchini lengthwise and scoop out the centers, leaving a 1 cm shell.
Finely chop the scooped flesh.
Mix rice, lentils, zucchini flesh, 150 g tomatoes, mint, parsley, cumin, half the oil, and half the salt.
Fill the four zucchini boats; put any extra filling beside them in a baking dish.
Mix remaining tomatoes, oil, and salt and spoon around the zucchini.
Cover the dish with foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake for another 10–15 minutes, until the zucchini is tender and the filling is steaming hot.
Serve two boats per person with the tomato sauce.

recipe.title: Roasted Cauliflower & Lentil Rice
recipe.description: A Lebanese-inspired bowl of cumin-roasted cauliflower, lentils, rice, and lemon parsley dressing. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 400 g cauliflower, cut into small florets
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C.
Toss cauliflower with half the oil, cumin, and half the salt.
Spread on a lined tray and roast for 25–30 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned.
Meanwhile, rinse rice and place in a saucepan with 220 ml water.
Bring to a boil, cover, and cook on low for 12 minutes.
Rest off the heat for 5 minutes.
Warm lentils in a small saucepan with 2 tbsp water for 3–4 minutes.
Whisk lemon juice, parsley, remaining oil, and remaining salt in a bowl.
Divide rice, lentils, and cauliflower between two bowls.
Spoon the lemon parsley dressing over them.

recipe.title: Roasted Pepper, Bean & Potato Tray
recipe.description: Sweet bell peppers and potatoes roasted with white beans and rosemary. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 350 g potatoes, cut into 1.5 cm cubes
300 g sweet red bell peppers, cut into strips
300 g cooked cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C.
Pat potatoes dry and toss with half the oil and half the salt.
Spread on a large lined tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Toss sweet bell peppers and beans with remaining oil, salt, and rosemary.
Add to the tray and turn the potatoes.
Roast for another 15–20 minutes, until potatoes are tender and peppers are softened with browned edges.
Drizzle with lemon juice and divide into two servings.

recipe.title: Roasted Pumpkin & Black Bean Rice
recipe.description: Cumin-roasted pumpkin over black bean rice, with a lime-cilantro finish. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 400 g peeled pumpkin, cut into 2 cm cubes
240 g cooked black beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C.
Toss pumpkin with oil, cumin, oregano, and half the salt.
Roast on a lined tray for 25–30 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and golden.
Meanwhile, rinse rice and combine with 220 ml water and remaining salt in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil, cover, and cook on low for 12 minutes.
Rest off the heat for 5 minutes.
Warm black beans with 2 tbsp water in a small saucepan for 4 minutes.
Fold into the cooked rice.
Divide bean rice into two bowls and top with pumpkin, lime juice, and cilantro.

recipe.title: Rosemary Focaccia
recipe.description: Golden, dimpled focaccia with rosemary and flaky salt, crisp outside and airy inside. Most of the time is the dough doing its own thing.
steps: Mix flour, yeast, salt, and water into a wet dough; rest 15 minutes.
Fold the dough a few times, then rise 1 hour until doubled.
Stretch into an oiled pan and rise another 30 minutes.
Dimple with oiled fingers, scatter rosemary and flaky salt.
Bake at 220°C for 22–25 minutes until deep golden.

recipe.title: Rosemary White Bean & Potato Soup
recipe.description: A thick white bean soup with potato, carrot, and rosemary. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 300 g cooked cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
250 g potatoes, cut into 1.5 cm cubes
steps: Heat oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add carrot and rosemary and cook for 4 minutes, stirring.
Add potatoes, water, and salt. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes, until potatoes are tender.
Add beans and simmer for 5 minutes. Mash a few beans and potato pieces against the pan to thicken the soup.
Stir in lemon juice and divide between two bowls.

recipe.title: Shakshuka
recipe.description: Eggs poached directly in a smoky pepper-and-tomato sauce, finished with feta and herbs. One pan, bread for dipping mandatory.
ingredients: 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1/2 tsp cumin
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in olive oil, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic and spices, then the tomatoes; simmer 10 minutes.
Make wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook until the whites set but yolks stay runny.
Crumble over feta and serve from the pan with bread.

recipe.title: Sopes
recipe.description: Warm masa rounds with beans, chicken, lettuce, crema, and crumbled cheese. Makes 10 sopes.
ingredients: cooked shredded chicken or beef, 1½ cups
steps: Mix the masa harina and warm water in a bowl.
Knead into a soft dough that holds together.
Divide the dough into 10 balls and keep them covered.
Press each ball into a thick disc.
Heat a griddle over medium-high heat.
Cook each disc for 1 minute per side, then turn once more and cook for 20–30 seconds.
Let the discs cool just enough to handle.
Pinch around the edges to make a raised rim.
Heat the oil or lard in a pan and lightly fry the sopes on both sides.
Drain the sopes on paper towels.
Spread with refried beans and add the cooked meat, lettuce, cheese, onion, crema, and salsa.

recipe.title: Spaghetti Carbonara
recipe.description: Silky Roman pasta made from eggs, Pecorino, and crisp guanciale — no cream needed. The starchy pasta water does the work.
steps: Boil the spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente.
Crisp the guanciale in a cold pan brought up to medium heat.
Whisk eggs, yolk, Pecorino, and plenty of black pepper.
Toss pasta with the guanciale off the heat.
Stir in the egg mix with a splash of pasta water until glossy.
Serve immediately with extra Pecorino and pepper.

recipe.title: Spinach Scrambled Eggs
recipe.description: Soft scrambled eggs folded with wilted spinach. It is a fast, protein-rich breakfast with very little prep.
steps: Whisk eggs with milk, salt, and pepper.
Wilt spinach in butter.
Add eggs and stir gently until softly set.

recipe.title: Spinach, Corn & Chickpea Rice
recipe.description: Basmati rice folded with spinach, sweet corn, chickpeas, and fragrant cumin. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 200 g cooked chickpeas, drained and rinsed
steps: Rinse rice and place in a saucepan with 220 ml water and half the salt.
Bring to a boil, cover, and cook on low for 12 minutes.
Rest off the heat for 5 minutes.
Heat oil in a wide pan.
Add cumin, ginger, and turmeric and stir for 30 seconds.
Add chickpeas, corn, and 3 tbsp water. Cook for 4 minutes.
Add spinach and remaining salt and cook for 3 minutes until wilted.
Fold in the cooked rice and heat through for 1 minute.
Divide between two bowls.

recipe.title: Sumac Chickpea & Potato Tray
recipe.description: Roasted potatoes and chickpeas with tangy sumac, parsley, and lemon; a Lebanese-inspired tray meal. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 400 g potatoes, cut into 2 cm cubes
240 g cooked chickpeas, drained and rinsed
150 g carrot, cut into 1 cm half-moons
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C.
Pat the potatoes and carrots dry.
Toss with oil, salt, and 1 tsp sumac on a large lined baking tray.
Spread in one layer and roast for 20 minutes.
Pat chickpeas dry, add them to the tray, and turn the vegetables.
Roast for another 15–20 minutes, until potatoes are tender and golden and chickpeas are hot.
Toss with the remaining sumac, lemon juice, and parsley.
Divide into two servings.

recipe.title: Tabbouleh
recipe.description: A Lebanese parsley salad — herbs first, bulgur second — sharpened with lemon and tossed with tomato and mint.
steps: Soak the bulgur in the tomato juices and half the lemon juice.
Chop the parsley and mint finely with a sharp knife.
Toss herbs, tomatoes, spring onions, and bulgur together.
Dress with olive oil, remaining lemon, and salt just before serving.

recipe.title: Tacos de Papa
recipe.description: Crisp corn tortillas filled with seasoned potato, finished with lettuce, crema, salsa, and crumbled cheese. Makes 6 servings.
ingredients: Russet potatoes — 2 lb, peeled and cubed
Toppings: shredded lettuce, cotija, Mexican crema, cilantro, salsa
steps: Put the potato cubes in a pot and cover them with water.
Bring to a boil, then simmer for 20–25 minutes, until soft.
Drain the potatoes.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a small pan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Mash the potatoes with the garlic butter, cumin, chili powder, and salt.
Place about ¼ cup filling on each warm tortilla and fold it in half.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat.
Fry the tacos in batches for about 2 minutes per side, until crisp.
Drain on paper towels.
Add lettuce, cotija, crema, cilantro, and salsa to serve.

recipe.title: Tinga de Pollo
recipe.description: Shredded chicken simmered with tomatoes, softened onion, and smoky chipotle. Makes 6 servings using already-cooked chicken.
ingredients: Parsley — 2 tbsp, chopped; extra for garnish
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the diced garlic and cook for 2 minutes.
Lower the heat and stir in the diced tomatoes and 2 tbsp parsley.
Cook for 6–7 minutes. Add a splash of water if the pan becomes dry.
Stir in the cooked shredded chicken and chopped chipotle peppers.
Simmer for 8 minutes, until the chicken is hot.
Season with salt and pepper, then finish with the extra parsley.

recipe.title: Tiramisu
recipe.description: Espresso-soaked ladyfingers layered with airy mascarpone cream and a dusting of cocoa. Make it ahead — it only gets better overnight.
steps: Whisk yolks with sugar until pale, then fold in mascarpone.
Whip the whites to soft peaks and fold into the cream.
Dip ladyfingers briefly in espresso and layer in a dish.
Spread half the cream, repeat the layers, and finish with cream.
Chill at least 4 hours, then dust generously with cocoa.

recipe.title: Tofu Vegetable Stir-Fry
recipe.description: Crisp tofu and mixed vegetables tossed with a quick tamari sauce. Serve it as-is or over rice.
steps: Cube and sear tofu.
Stir-fry vegetables with garlic.
Add tamari and tofu, then toss together.

recipe.title: Tomato Basil Pasta
recipe.description: Simple pasta tossed with garlic, olive oil, tomato, and basil. It tastes fresh while using mostly pantry ingredients.
steps: Boil pasta until al dente.
Cook garlic in olive oil, then add crushed tomatoes.
Toss pasta with sauce and basil.

recipe.title: Tomato Egg Drop Soup
recipe.description: A light soup with tomato, broth, and silky ribbons of egg. It comes together fast and feels comforting.
steps: Simmer tomato in broth.
Thicken lightly with cornstarch slurry.
Stream in beaten eggs and garnish with scallion.

recipe.title: Tomato White Beans over Polenta
recipe.description: Soft polenta topped with tomato-basil white beans. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 300 g cooked cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
steps: In a saucepan, combine oil, tomatoes, oregano, half the salt, and 100 ml water.
Simmer over medium-low heat for 10 minutes.
Add beans and simmer for another 5 minutes.
Stir in half the basil.
Meanwhile, bring 500 ml water and remaining salt to a boil in another saucepan.
Whisk in polenta slowly.
Reduce the heat and stir for 5–8 minutes, or follow the packet, until smooth and tender.
Divide polenta between two bowls, spoon beans and tomato sauce over it, and finish with the remaining basil.

recipe.title: Tomato, White Bean & Rice Soup
recipe.description: A mild Mexican-inspired tomato rice soup with white beans, carrot, oregano, and lime. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 300 g cooked cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Warm oil in a large saucepan.
Add carrot and cook for 4 minutes.
Add oregano and cumin and stir for 20 seconds.
Add rinsed rice, tomatoes, water, and salt.
Bring to a boil, then simmer partly covered for 18 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add white beans and simmer for 5 minutes, until the rice and carrots are tender and beans are hot.
Add water if a thinner soup is preferred.
Stir in lime juice and cilantro.
Divide into two bowls.

recipe.title: Tuna Rice Bowl
recipe.description: A fast rice bowl with canned tuna, cucumber, tamari, and sesame. It is easiest with leftover rice.
steps: Warm the rice.
Top with tuna and cucumber.
Season with tamari, sesame oil, and sesame seeds.

recipe.title: Vegetable Biryani
recipe.description: Fragrant basmati layered over spiced vegetables and steamed with saffron, mint, and fried onions. A one-pot celebration.
ingredients: 300 g mixed vegetables (carrot, beans, cauliflower, peas)
A pinch of saffron in 3 tbsp warm milk
steps: Fry the sliced onions until deep golden; set half aside.
Cook the vegetables with yogurt and biryani masala into a thick gravy.
Parboil the rice with whole spices until 70% done.
Layer rice over the vegetables with mint, fried onions, and saffron milk.
Steam on the lowest heat, covered, for 20 minutes; rest before fluffing.

recipe.title: Zucchini & Basil White Bean Rice
recipe.description: A creamy-textured rice pot with zucchini, mashed white beans, lemon, and basil. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 240 g cooked cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
300 g zucchini, cut into 1 cm cubes
steps: Mash half the beans with 3 tbsp of the hot water.
Keep the remaining water hot in a small saucepan.
Heat oil in a wide saucepan.
Add zucchini and cook for 4 minutes.
Add rice and stir for 1 minute.
Add salt and 200 ml hot water.
Simmer, stirring frequently, adding the remaining water a ladle at a time as the rice absorbs it.
Cook for 18–22 minutes until the rice is tender; use extra water if needed.
Stir in mashed and whole beans and cook for 2 minutes.
Fold in lemon juice and basil.
Divide into two servings.

recipe.title: Zucchini, Corn & Pinto Calabacitas
recipe.description: A mild calabacitas-inspired skillet with zucchini, sweet corn, pinto beans, and tomato. Makes 2 servings.
ingredients: 350 g zucchini, cut into 1.5 cm cubes
300 g cooked pinto beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add zucchini and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add tomatoes, corn, cumin, salt, and water.
Cover and simmer for 7 minutes, until zucchini is tender.
Stir in pinto beans and cook uncovered for 4–5 minutes, until hot and excess liquid has reduced.
Finish with lime juice and cilantro and divide into two servings.
